topography.project_purpose: Prediction Market. Structurally: 21 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 16 common project-authored base contract(s) (ifees, ifeesee, ihashing). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
